name: Wriedel (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Wriedel (a green half-timbered house between trees on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Wriedel; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wriedel arms — house between trees on yellow
